summary: Build confident delivery, sharper slides, and stronger Q&A handling. Enrol in advanced training for real workplace presentations.
lede: Public speaking and presentation skills provide a repeatable way to plan, structure, and deliver messages that inform, persuade, and influence an audience. This course develops audience analysis, message mapping, persuasive framing, vocal control, nonverbal delivery, and disciplined responses to questions. Through realistic presentation briefs, you will build and rehearse presentations, simplify slides, design stronger openings and closings, and practise practical rehearsal and feedback methods. The course is designed for high-pressure settings where time is limited, attention is scarce, and your ideas must be communicated clearly to move decisions forward.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already present in work settings and need sharper control, stronger message architecture, and more executive impact.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: practical experience presenting in meetings, briefings, pitches, or internal reviews; confidence using PowerPoint, Google Slides, or comparable slide software; willingness to be video-recorded during practice sessions; and the ability to bring one real presentation topic for workshop exercises. No coding is required. This is an advanced-level course at the operational and implementation-practice level for speaking, slide design, rehearsal, and delivery.
